title: Counter-Selector Wave 33: public handoff package truth table
purpose: Distinguish a handoff label, a reusable checklist, a named-recipient package surface, and a security-restricted rotation surface from an actually completed recipient-acknowledged state package.

complete_public_package_requires: identified outgoing unit and incoming unit
versioned package identity and repository location
open decisions, risks, bugs, deadlines, and owners
rollback, refusal, emergency, and safe-decline conditions
recipient acknowledgment of the identified package
successor operation from the transferred state
independent inspectability or an explicit source-restriction ceiling

controls.public_label: named-recipient product-feature handover package with unresolved production state

source_records.title: Handover DAP role-based permissions to Authorization group
source_records.artifact_scope: Names outgoing and incoming groups and recipients; inventories implementation components, UAT, known bugs, feature flags, documentation, monitoring, open questions, handover tasks, post-handover tasks, success criteria, and a support period.

source_records.title: Phase 2: Implement role-based access permissions for DAP
source_records.artifact_scope: States that Phase 1 was handed over to the Authorization group and preserves remaining Phase 1 work plus Phase 2 scope.

source_records.title: DAP role-based permissions Self-Managed UAT
source_records.artifact_scope: Linked from the handover package as the completed Self-Managed UAT and partial walkthrough surface.

source_records.title: Draft role-based permissions documentation
source_records.artifact_scope: Linked from the handover package as prepared documentation whose publication depends on later feature-flag and production state.

counterevidence: The handover checklist and success criteria remain presented as tasks rather than completed receipts.
Feature flags, documentation publication, monitoring, and several production issues remain unresolved or sequenced after bug fixes.
CODEOWNERS, handbook ownership, alerts, issue assignment, credentials, and access completion are not publicly receipted.
The successor epic acknowledges the handover at group scope but does not acknowledge a versioned package or its completeness.
A two-week predecessor support window can mask hidden state rather than prove independent resumability.

controls.public_label: handover-titled pull request containing branding cleanup only

source_records.title: chore: Prepare the project for handover
source_records.artifact_scope: The merged diff removes a Docker badge and a VirtusLab Slack link and changes the copyright label to Jenkins Operator Community; it contains no state package, recipient, authority transfer, credential ledger, or open-decision inventory.

source_records.title: Jenkins Kubernetes Operator v0.8.0-beta release
source_records.artifact_scope: Lists PR 800 as preparation for handover but does not supply additional package or recipient evidence.

counterevidence: The diff changes project presentation rather than operational state.
No outgoing or incoming operator is named.
No package, authority, credentials, dependencies, risks, deadlines, or rollback conditions are present.
A release note repeating the PR title does not add handoff evidence.
Community branding may accompany a real transition elsewhere, but this pull request does not preserve that transition.

controls.public_label: reusable project, code, system, and completeness checklist

source_records.title: Project Handover Checklist
source_records.artifact_scope: Provides project, code, system, and handover-completeness checklists and instructs users to instantiate and execute them for a real transition.

counterevidence: A checklist describes what should exist; it does not prove any item was executed.
No outgoing or incoming operator is attached to the template.
Checked boxes in a future fork would still require underlying receipts.
Template completeness does not establish package completeness.
A good schema can reduce omissions without proving successor operation.

controls.public_label: security rotation with public receipt shell and restricted handover content

source_records.title: Composition Analysis - Reaction Rotation 18.7
source_records.artifact_scope: Names primary and secondary operators, requires an internal handover thread, asks the prior primary for ongoing tasks, context, and pending items, and tracks the incoming rotation's work; security-sensitive package contents are intentionally not public.

counterevidence: The public issue cannot establish package completeness because the handover thread is intentionally internal.
A checked internal-handover task does not expose credentials, decisions, risks, or rollback state for independent review.
Security restrictions can be legitimate and must not be converted into a negative capability finding.
Incoming operation can coexist with hidden predecessor dependence.
The correct state is source-restricted, not complete and not failed.

next_action: Apply the package truth table to new candidate and control lanes; seek a versioned outgoing package, package-level recipient acknowledgment, authority and credential ledger, dependency and open-decision inventory, rollback conditions, and observed successor operation without contacting source subjects.
